;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**Forty-seven insurgents and five [[Egyptian Army|Egyptian soldiers]] are killed in a gunfight in the Sinai Peninsula. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/middleeast/2019/05/egypt-sinai-47-fighters-5-troops-killed-battle-190516133026261.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Multiple people are killed, including three militants, two Mujahideen, two civilians and two [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]], in [[Kashmir]] after a shootout. [https://af.reuters.com/article/worldNews/idAFKCN1SM0ZC (Reuters)]
;Business and economy
*The [[Federal government of the United States|U.S. Government]] under the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] cancels {{nowrap|$929 million}} federal grant for [[California]] [[California High-Speed Rail|High-Speed Rail]] project. [https://www.latimes.com/local/california/la-me-high-speed-rail-loses-federal-funding-20190516-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*Three Britons and a South African die when their light aircraft crashes on approach to [[Dubai International Airport]], closing the world's busiest airport for 45 minutes. [https://news.sky.com/story/three-britons-killed-as-small-plane-crashes-in-dubai-11721737 (Sky News)]
;International relations
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**Field Marshal [[Khalifa Haftar]] of the Tobruk-based [[House of Representatives (Libya)|House of Representatives]] meets with Italian Prime Minister [[Giuseppe Conte]] and has scheduled a meeting with French President [[Emmanuel Macron]] for next week. [https://www.libyaobserver.ly/news/italian-prime-minister-meets-haftar-rome-calls-ceasefire (Libya Observer)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-france/frances-macron-to-meet-libyas-eastern-commander-haftar-next-week-presidency-idUSKCN1SM204 (Reuters)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Mayor of New York City]] [[Bill de Blasio]] announces [[Bill de Blasio 2020 presidential campaign|he is running]] for the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party's]] nomination to be [[President of the United States]] in [[2020 United States presidential election|the 2020 presidential election]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/may/16/bill-de-blasio-2020-presidential-campaign (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Immigration policy of Donald Trump]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] proposes a new immigration plan based on merits such as college degrees and skilled trades and less on family ties. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/15/us/politics/trump-immigration-kushner.html (''The New York Times'')]
*U.S. federal agents raid the [[Venezuela]]n embassy to evict [[Code Pink]] protesters, at the request of [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|National Assembly]] leader [[Juan Guaidó]]. They had been staying at the embassy at the invitation of Venezuelan President [[Nicolás Maduro]], who is locked in a [[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis|dispute over the presidency]] with Guaidó. Maduro's government considers the raid to be a violation of the [[Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations|Vienna convention]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-washingtondc/u-s-federal-agents-arrest-protesters-occupying-venezuelan-embassy-idUSKCN1SM21T (Reuters)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/us-police-venezuela-embassy-vienna-convention-maduro-guaido-a8917361.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Brexit negotiations in 2019]], [[Premiership of Theresa May]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] says that she will detail the timetable for her resignation after the [[Brexit]] vote in June. [https://www.ft.com/content/f6be9a3c-77de-11e9-bbad-7c18c0ea0201 (''FT'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/16/world/europe/uk-theresa-may.html (''The New York Times'')] [http://time.com/5590944/uk-prime-minister-theresa-may-june-timetable-resign/ (''Time'')]
